caption_final:
Scene is a solid pass rather than a rave. Most reviews idly read enjoy Suriya sending up his own hero image in Jithu Madhavan's offbeat cop comedy; the complaints are pacing that sags in stretches and, for two critics, jokes that wear thin. Hindustan Times's Neeshita Nyayapati: "Suriya truly has fun poking fun at himself".

idly's consolidated score: 6.3/10, the mean of 15 numeric ratings from idly's fixed panel of 47 Indian English-language outlets (newspapers, TV and news sites, established film publications), published on or after release and confirmed on the outlet's page or in two independent listings, converted to /10.

Suriya plays a cop who would rather not be one: which star would you most like to see send up their own image next?

Sources: ratings from Cinema Express, Times of India, OnlyKollywood, Filmfare, Hindustan Times, India Today, NDTV, Pinkvilla, Indian Express, The Week, Deccan Herald, Great Andhra, Gulte, Telugu360 and Deccan Chronicle; read on the outlets' pages or in thereviewmonk, Rotten Tomatoes, Sacnilk and BollyMovieReviewz.
